clips.title: The story
paras: Demon Fall Canyon bears the scars of the battle that freed the orcs from the blood curse. Here, Thrall and Grommash Hellscream faced Mannoroth in southern Ashenvale.

In southern Ashenvale, the canyon lies near Felfire Hill and Demon Fall Ridge, its land scarred by the Third War. Warchief Thrall and chieftain Grommash Hellscream tracked the pit lord Mannoroth here to break his hold over the Horde. Mannoroth struck Thrall down, and Grom seized the chance to drive his axe, Gorehowl, into the demon’s chest. The infernal blast shattered Mannoroth and killed Grom. With the pit lord’s death, the orcs were free of their lingering demonic servitude.

The Horde named the canyon for Grom’s final stand and raised a monument nearby to honor his redemption. Mannoroth’s death unleashed demonic power that tainted the surrounding land. Fel magic still saturates the canyon, where lesser demons roam. Pilgrims who come to this hallowed ground face danger at every turn.
